text:
ops_bot: incident-bot detected SLO burn: p99 inference latency > 5s for service 'text-gen' in us-west-2, firing PagerDuty

pagerduty_bot: PagerDuty page fired -> PD incident ID PD-89321, urgency: high, alert: SLO_BURN_LATENCY_text-gen_us-west-2

alex_kim: acked the page (PD-89321) :hand: I'm on it, grabbing dashboards now

maria_garcia: seeing p95 ~1.2s but p99 spiking to 6-8s, tail looks concentrated on long-seq requests. Rolling 5m window shows backend GPU queue growth.

samir_rao: confirmed KV cache miss rate jumped 4x correlated with the tail. Could be cache eviction/pressure from a rogue workload.

jess_lee: any recent model rollouts? Canary config?

alex_kim: no new model rollouts in the last 24h. Autoscaler did add pods earlier (scheduled) but they didn't keep up with KV thrash.

maria_garcia: timeline: at 15:02 p99 rose, at 15:05 autoscaler attempted +2 pods, at 15:07 queue backlog increased, at 15:10 PagerDuty triggered.

samir_rao: I'm going to temporarily reduce max_batch_size and force smaller batches to reduce latency tail. Pushing config change now.

alex_kim: ok push command?

samir_rao: ```
# update runtime config
redwoodctl runtimes update text-gen --region us-west-2 --set max_batch_size=8 --set batch_timeout_ms=20
```

ops_bot: config update accepted, applying to pool text-gen-usw2-1

maria_garcia: also enabling fallback routing to lower-capacity model-compact for best-effort traffic to protect critical routes. Adding a slow-fallback rule for non-SLA customers.

alex_kim: traffic shift set: route policy 'latency-protect' -> 10% to model-compact, 90% to text-gen. Command: `redwoodctl route update --policy latency-protect --shift 10%`

pagerduty_bot: PD update: PD-89321 acknowledged by alex_kim, assigned to oncall-primary. Escalation timer suspended.

samir_rao: after config change, p99 dropped from ~6.5s -> ~3.2s within 90s. KV miss-rate still elevated but stabilizing.

jess_lee: any customer-impact? Which customers hit the fallback?

maria_garcia: flagged two high-revenue tenants (acct: acme-corp, acct: edu-solutions) saw increased error rate on long sequences. Reached out to SEs to notify and offer mitigation.

alex_kim: I opened an emergency support ticket, referencing PD-89321, letting SEs know we shifted traffic and reduced batch size.

samir_rao: I'm going to force a KV cache warming job for hot prefixes, small script to prime kv entries for top 200 prefixes. Running now.

ops_bot: job started: kv-warm-top-prefixes-2198765432 (eta 60s)

maria_garcia: metrics now: p95 0.9s, p99 2.1s after warm + batch change. Still above target but within acceptable for now. Keeping page open until stable for 10m.

alex_kim: we should consider longer-term fixes: adjust eviction policy, add LRU-weigher, and investigating which tenant is causing pattern. I'll create a ticket in infra backlog.

jess_lee: great. Also please capture a replay for the eval team — want to run the prompt set to check quality differences between text-gen and model-compact.

samir_rao: noted. I pushed a rollback-safe patch to autoscaler to avoid overprovisioning nodes for short-lived bursts (will PR with metrics).

maria_garcia: oncall handoff in 12m. I'll stay as primary until handoff complete; if anything spikes re-page. Otherwise I'll update PD with resolution summary after we close.

pagerduty_bot: PD-89321 note: incident in mitigation, responders: alex_kim, maria_garcia, samir_rao, jess_lee.

alex_kim: quick checklist for postmortem: root cause, KV eviction tuning, autoscaler cooldown tuning, routing policy defaults. I'll draft.

maria_garcia: thanks team :thumbsup: I'll post a short incident summary once metrics are stable and then close PD.

ops_bot: incident-bot: monitoring for recurrence for 30m after last spike. If p99 > 4s again, will re-fire page. :eyes:
